title: Ask your data
tryWithClaude: Ask Claude: which product category had the best margin last year?

steps.say: Ask your data answers a question about your numbers. You type it in plain words.
Press Ask and the answer comes back as a table. Semanticus checks it before it shows you.
You can ask about time too. Net sales and gross margin rose each quarter.
Switch to Chart to see the same numbers as bars. Show DAX shows the query that ran.
To go deeper, open Queries. Right-click a number there and choose Explain.
